name: Stop Time
description:
You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4+1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

The spell ends if you or an effect you create affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than far range from the location where you cast it.
